policies.scope: Eleven complete necessary candidate dependencies, zero new Standard collectible roots. Six older Paladin/Mech collectibles and five actual forms/tokens; TIME_016 and Hellion remain unsupported. No restricted source pool or registered-definition filter is added; exact past eligibility and formal pools remain M0/M6.
policies.corrupt: Native Corrupt with exact Carousel Gryphon5/5 Divine Shield and corrupted8/8 Divine Shield/Taunt. Original paid higher-cost play witness, local modifiers, same physical card and ordinary upgrade lifecycle are delegated to HandProgressSpec; no card-local progress counter.
policies.troupe: Annoy-o-Troupe uses the exact fixed-source69718 CORE_GVG_085 identity, pinned complete and unchanged. Three attributed ordered-group members use original natural Deathrattle slot or live-carrier right side. Native quantity, capacity, recipient identity and actual deliveries remain public; exact grouping and CN windows remain M6.
policies.leviathan: Leviathan has one explicit right-side Claw appendage under existing Colossal policy, Rush and Divine Shield on both actual faces. Each surviving original minion completed attack separately invokes native Dredge or Draw. Original physical attacker zone epoch and entered order gate rewards; bare combat, other attackers and same-ID reentry do not impersonate the original declaration. Exact side/entry/attack reward windows remain internal pending M6.
policies.mooncatcher: Azsharan Mooncatcher creates the exact Sunken Mooncatcher at deck bottom via ordinary AddToDeck, without a semantic random-shuffle claim. Sunken Battlecry copies its original live board presence with full native current-copy material and causing-card attribution; copied entry does not invent another Battlecry.
policies.hellbat: Independent Hellbat form gives other friendly active minions additive+2 Attack and native continuous Rush, including non-Mechs, excluding itself. No Hellion hand transformation or Starship history rule is added; aura source/copy/control/silence remain native.
policies.noble: Noble Minibot has ordinary Mech Magnetic and an actual same-original-attacker completion listener. Native RandomBuffStoredMinion selects a current physical hand minion and applies+1/+1; spells are not candidates, and source retirement after accepted reward does not change the original root.
policies.forge: Muscle-o-Tron native Forge costs2 and upgrades the same hand entity to its exact forged form without playing it. Actual Battlecry grants+1/+1 or+2/+2 to original captured hand minions using BuffMinionsInZones. Forge and card-play payments/history, hand acquisition and original reference invalidation remain public.
policies.gaps: END_017 has no trusted effective default hand-capacity operand in RuleContext; do not hardcode10. Current discard-copy material is explicitly hand-delivery only, so CATA_494 is not registered. Holy-spell cost reduction is not an allowed PlayerSpellCountCostSpec profile, so both MIS_918 forms remain unsupported. Seafloor Savior source-stat capture across Dredge is left for main review.
